title: Proof that the Klein-Gordon type equation with alpha attractor potential has no Liouvillian solution or as a composition of special functions
summary: This study investigates the analytical solvability of the Klein-Gordon and Duffin-Kemmer-Petiau (DKP) equations for a scalar particle interacting with a transcendental $α$-attractor-type potential, $V(x) = V_0 e^{a \tanh(bx)}$. We first address the problem of integrability within the framework of Picard-Vessiot theory. By analyzing the differential field extensions associated with the system, we demonstrated that the differential Galois group is the full special linear group $SL(2, \mathbb{C})$.
